title: Using the emergency screen
description: Get help and guidance fast when something goes wrong.

steps.text: Open the Emergency screen (dashboard or More → Tools).
Tap 'What to do if…' and pick the situation.
Follow the guidance step by step.
Use Share location to send your GPS position.

tips: Share your location with a contact or marina.
examples: Tapping What to do if for overheating.
Sharing your GPS position after a breakdown.
